phases.name: The Feather Falls
phases.say: Your hearts are heavy. All of them. I have weighed them.

say.open: Step onto the scale. One of you, or all of you. It is all the same to me.

bestiary.lore: The jackal-headed judge of the dead, who weighs a heart against a feather and feeds the heavy ones to the thing beneath his scales.
bestiary.weakness: Holy and Water. Heal or shield whoever the Scales Mark before the Devourer lands.
bestiary.pattern: The Scales Mark the least sane; every third turn the Devourer charges at whoever is Marked; jackal strikes on the Back between. At half the Devourer comes every other turn and sand blinds a row.
